name: Ooredoo Qatar Data Centres (portfolio of 5 facilities)
notes: Ooredoo official page confirms Qatar Data Centres portfolio (Government Data Centre, colocation, cloud backup) designed to Tier III standards, ~60,000 sq ft across 5 facilities in Doha; individual site addresses not publicly disclosed. DCD (2014) reported Ooredoo opening a new data center floor. Per-site MW not disclosed.

name: Ooredoo Government Data Centre (GDC2) / MoTC government-hosting expansion
developer: Ooredoo Qatar / Ministry of Transport & Communications (MoTC)
notes: Ooredoo page (A) lists Government Data Centre offering; Gulf Times (B) reported MoTC-Ooredoo agreement to expand the Government Data Centre, which houses Qatari government workloads. Address not disclosed; mapped to Doha via Ooredoo's Doha portfolio. No per-project MW.

name: Doha IX (Ooredoo + DE-CIX)
notes: First commercial carrier-neutral IX in Qatar, launched October 2025, hosted in an Ooredoo data centre in Doha (DE-CIX as-a-service model), connected to DE-CIX Marseille. Official Ooredoo/DE-CIX press releases. IXP/connectivity record - not a DC building.

name: Google Cloud Doha region (me-central1)
notes: Google Cloud region Doha (me-central1, zones a/b/c) confirmed via official Google SKU/service pages (BigQuery, Cloud SQL, etc. listed for Doha me-central1) and third-party region lists. Region record only - physical DC address not public. AWS and Oracle OCI have no Qatar public region (verified negative on official region lists); do not infer buildings.

name: Microsoft Azure Qatar Central (qatarcentral)
notes: Azure region Qatar Central (qatarcentral), Doha, GA since 2022 per Microsoft Learn region list (A). DCD reported the Doha Azure region is hosted at MEEZA's QSTP data centre (M-VAULT 4, Al Rayyan municipality). Region record only - address not otherwise public.

name: Quantum Switch DOA-A / DOA-B (Doha colocation)
notes: Directory evidence: Quantum Switch DOA-A in Doha with 6 MW total capacity (3 MW reserved, potential site expansion to 24 MW); second facility DOA-B also in Doha (PeeringDB org 34363). A 2026 LinkedIn post by a Quantum Switch employee mentions Doha expansion works adding 4.5 MW. Directory/social grade; facility not independently verified.

name: Ooredoo Doha cable landing station (FALCON / AAE-1)
notes: Connectivity record: Submarine Networks lists Ooredoo Doha CLS as landing station for FALCON (AAE-1 family) in Qatar; Vodafone North Doha CLS and Halul Island CLS also serve Qatar cables. Cable landings are connectivity evidence, not DC buildings.

name: NavLink Qatar Data Center (historical)
notes: NavLink corporate page claims experience building/operating a 'Qatar Data Center' in Doha among EMEA sites. Country methodology records a 2007 Energy City Qatar (Lusail, Al Daayen) MoU for a NavLink data centre with no current public construction/operation evidence found. Historic/lead record; status and capacity unverified.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 4 (QSTP)
notes: M-VAULT 4 is at Qatar Science & Technology Park (QSTP, Al Rayyan municipality) - reported by DCD as the biggest data centre building in Qatar and host of Microsoft's Doha Azure cloud region (announced 2020, inaugurated 2021). Press Arabia (2026): MEEZA signed a QR 100M+ deal to deliver 1 MW capacity in M-VAULT 4 to a global hyperscaler. Building capacity not otherwise disclosed.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 5 (QSTP) incl. 4 MW hyperscaler expansion
notes: M-VAULT 5 launched 17 Oct 2022 as MEEZA's 5th data centre building at QSTP (Al Rayyan). DCD reports MEEZA completed a 4 MW expansion project for an unnamed global hyperscaler at the M-VAULT 5 facility (QSTP), delivered nine months ahead of schedule. 4 MW expansion is B-grade press detail; building/operator A.

name: GBI QSTP-LLC (cloud/connectivity provider HQ)
notes: QSTP directory (A/B) lists GBI QSTP-LLC headquartered at QSTP (Al Rayyan); GBI owns submarine/terrestrial fibre meshed network and was to be combined with QNBN by QIA (QNA, Oct 2024). No public GBI-operated DC building in Qatar confirmed - lead/context record only.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 2 (Umm Qarn)
notes: qix.qa official contact page (A) names 'Meeza (MV2) Datacenter Umm Qarn' as QIX point; Wikipedia Al Daayen records the MEEZA Data Center south of Umm Qarn, inaugurated 2014, ~10,000 sq m (then MEEZA's largest); PeeringDB fac/8069 lists MV2 with QIX Qatar. Directory sources conflict on municipality (some place Umm Qarn on the Al Daayen/Umm Salal border; RebootMonkey claims QSTP) - Al Daayen per official QIX mapping and Wikipedia Al Daayen; C-grade conflicts noted. Capacity not disclosed.

name: QIX (Qatar Internet Exchange)
notes: Official QIX page: exchange points at MEEZA MV2, Umm Qarn (Al Daayen); PCH IXP record confirms Qatar Internet Exchange Point at Umm Qarn / Meeza MV2 (established 2020). IXP/connectivity record, not a DC building.

division: Qatar Free Zones (Ras Bufontas or Umm Alhoul - not disclosed)
name: Q Data QFZ hyperscale facilities (Syntys/Ooredoo)
developer: Syntys (Ooredoo Group) / Q Data QFZ LLC (ex-Doha Venture Capital)
notes: DCD/Total Telecom (2026): Ooredoo's Syntys acquired Q Data QFZ LLC, gaining two Tier III-certified carrier-neutral facilities inside the Qatar Free Zones - 5 MW live IT capacity plus 7.5 MW under development (12.5 MW total). Precise zone (Ras Bufontas near HIA in the Doha/HIA area, or Umm Alhoul near Hamad Port in Al Wakrah) is not publicly disclosed, so the project does not map to a single municipality; QFZ lists data-centre/cloud services as a resident industry (qfz.gov.qa).

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 3
notes: MEEZA official statements (A) describe M-VAULT 3 as Tier III / LEED Gold certified within their five M-VAULT portfolio (99.98% uptime claim). Precise location not verified: RebootMonkey (C) places MV2/MV3 on the same QSTP campus in Ar Rayyan; methodology keeps MV3 position unverified. Capacity not disclosed.

name: MEEZA M-VAULT 6 / 7 / 8 (planned expansion)
notes: Telecompaper: MEEZA secured QR 2 bln additional funding to develop M-Vault 6, 7 and 8 data centres in Qatar (2025/2026), aimed at hyperscalers, enterprise and government. datacenterHawk (C) lists M-Vault 6 at Umm Qarn, ~0.11 mi from M-Vault 2 - location unverified. Status planned; capacity not disclosed.

name: Vodafone Qatar data centre services (lead)
notes: Operator-level lead only: no public Vodafone Qatar data centre facility page, permit, or named facility evidence found on run date (English/Arabic sweeps). Methodology grades Vodafone Qatar DC services U (weak public facility evidence).
